name: Centum Distributor Pricing Module
description: Enriches CBOM with live distributor pricing (Digi-Key, Mouser, Element14), detects alternates, and exports pricing workbooks.

tools.name: centum_distributor_pricing__enrich_bom
tools.description: Enrich BOM parts with live distributor pricing from Digi-Key/Mouser/Element14 APIs.

tools.name: centum_distributor_pricing__export_enriched_bom
tools.description: Export the distributor-enriched BOM as a pricing workbook Excel file.

tools.name: centum_distributor_pricing__export_quote_summary
tools.description: Export a quote summary Excel workbook aggregating distributor pricing by part.

tools.name: centum_distributor_pricing__detect_alternates
tools.description: HITL gate: detect alternate parts for unquoted/overpriced CPNs and flag for human review.

tools.name: centum_distributor_pricing__apply_alternatives
tools.description: Apply human-reviewed alternate part selections to the CBOM.
